requirements: R1: Reconcile internal task states with actual GitHub PR states

slices.title: CI Status Reconciliation Patch
slices.jtbd: When implementing the reconciliation patch for this epic, I want to sync local statuses with GitHub PRs, so that blocked tasks are visible and operational reality is accurate
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a local task marked as 'done'
When the corresponding GitHub PR is not merged or closed
Then the local task status should be updated to reflect the true GitHub PR state
Given a PR state changes in GitHub
When the reconciliation runs
Then the local system should correctly reflect the new state
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce mismatch percentage between local task statuses and GitHub PR states from unknown to 0%
